verdict.rationale: Datadog's Log Management, Dashboards, and API Reference docs imply a documented query/search syntax for ad hoc telemetry analysis, and community evidence confirms real-world ad hoc querying workflows (e.g., turning a field into a custom search dimension, correlating APM/metrics/logs via tagging). However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents a formal query language reference/spec. Missing for 10: an explicit query-language syntax reference doc, independent hands-on validation of query language depth/expressiveness.
